change.summary: Preload multiple chronological probability/BF16-V operands in the deep ctx4096 partial-PV owners before replaying the unchanged ordered F32 recurrence.
change.scope: Use prefetch4 in ordinary global layers 32/36/40/44 and prefetch16 in compensated layer 28, only at live >=98304 while dense-initial identity remains valid.
change.unchanged: Score and denominator arithmetic, ordinary or Kahan FMA order, cross-split merge, softplus gate, BF16 rounding, KVLiveSpans ABI, non-temporal K/V policy, and metadata-aware eviction fallback.
